name: FCX/NEM Price Ratio Mean-Reversion Analysis
description: Analyzes the FCX/NEM price ratio for mean-reversion opportunities. Shows the ratio with its 120-day moving average, a 120-day rolling z-score with ±2σ bands, and measures average 20-day forward returns after extreme z-score readings (crossover above +2 or crossunder below -2). Includes hit rate, signal count, and average z-score at entry for both overbought and oversold regimes.
source:
# =============================================================================
# FCX/NEM PRICE RATIO MEAN-REVERSION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Ratio: FCX close / NEM close
# Z-Score: 120-day rolling z-score of ratio
# Signals: Z crosses above +2 (overbought) or below -2 (oversold)
# Outcome: 20-day forward return on the ratio after each signal
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
fcx_close = src.c

nem_data = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
nem_close = ffill(nem_data.c)

# --- Price Ratio & Trend ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close
ratio_ma = ma(period=120)(ratio)

# --- 120-Day Rolling Z-Score ---
ratio_z = zscore(window=120)(ratio)

# --- Signal Detection (first crossing of ±2σ) ---
is_overbought = crossover(ratio_z, 2)    # Z crosses above +2 → ratio stretched high
is_oversold = crossunder(ratio_z, -2)     # Z crosses below -2 → ratio stretched low
is_signal = is_overbought or is_oversold

# --- 20-Day Forward Return on Ratio ---
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(ratio)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME-FILTERED SERIES FOR SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

# Overbought signals (z > +2 → expect ratio to fall → "win" if fwd return < 0)
ob_fwd = where(is_overbought, fwd_20d)
ob_hit = where(is_overbought and is_valid(fwd_20d), 1.0 if fwd_20d < 0 else 0.0)
ob_z = where(is_overbought, ratio_z)

# Oversold signals (z < -2 → expect ratio to rise → "win" if fwd return > 0)
os_fwd = where(is_oversold, fwd_20d)
os_hit = where(is_oversold and is_valid(fwd_20d), 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
os_z = where(is_oversold, ratio_z)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKER HELPERS
# =============================================================================

ev_z = where(is_signal, ratio_z)
ev_ratio = where(is_signal, ratio)
ev_fwd = where(is_signal, fwd_20d)
ev_direction = conditional_select(is_overbought, 1.0, is_oversold, -1.0, 0.0 / 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

bar_ts = index()

# --- Chart 1: Ratio with 120-Day MA ---
xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Price Ratio with 120-Day Moving Average',
    category='1. Ratio & Z-Score',
    y_axis_label='Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FCX/NEM Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='120-Day MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma))

# --- Chart 2: Z-Score with ±2σ bands ---
xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Ratio Z-Score (120-Day) — ±2σ Extremes Mark Entry Points',
    category='1. Ratio & Z-Score',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ (Overbought)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ (Oversold)', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=ratio_z)

# --- Summary Table: Signal Performance ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Mean-Reversion Signal Stats: Avg 20-Day Forward Return at ±2σ Extremes',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Ratio Overbought (Z > +2)', 'Ratio Oversold (Z < -2)'],
        col_headers=['Avg 20d Fwd Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Signal Count', 'Avg Z at Entry'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Signal Performance',
    order=2
)(ob_fwd, ob_hit, ob_fwd, ob_z, os_fwd, os_hit, os_fwd, os_z)

# --- Event Markers: ±2σ Z-Score Signals ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Z-Score Extreme Signals (±2σ)',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge, title='Direction (1=OB, -1=OS)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Ratio Level', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='20d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_signal, ev_z, ev_direction, ev_ratio, ev_fwd)
